prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Mercury (Hg) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a hydrogen filling station at dusk, white dispensers under a lit canopy and a row of tall gas cylinders
Outfit: a sleek fitted one-piece ski suit with goggles pushed up on her head — in a monochrome palette of black and charcoal with at most one white or grey accent; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a small sealed glass vial with a single bead of quicksilver rolling inside in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — mercury: the only metal that is liquid at room temperature — quicksilver that pools, beads into round mirror droplets and rolls away from any touch; born from blood-red cinnabar ore, the vermilion of lacquer and seal paste; the living metal of the alchemists, named for Mercury the winged messenger god; the silver column rising in thermometers and barometers, the tin amalgam behind old mirrors; beautiful but poisonous, quick and capricious — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
